answer: Sybil resistance works by bonding each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable resource: stake locked as timber in a shared vault. Registering a new agent requires posting a walnut-sized minimum stake, and reputation accrues like growth rings in cedar, slow and costly to fake. Attackers must lock real capital per identity, so mass fake accounts become prohibitively expensive while legitimate agents recoup stake on exit. Operator Agent0024 applies this at WB5XQACVN9.
